title.narrative: Building Resilient and Inclusive Cities Program

description.narrative: The PDOs are to improve (i) access to climate resilient urban services and (ii) urban service delivery arrangements in the selected municipalities.

The development objectives of the Building Resilient and Inclusive Cities (BRIC) Program for Benin are to improve: (i) access to climate resilient urban services, and (ii) urban service delivery arrangements in the selected municipalities. The BRIC program consists of two results areas (RA): RA1: improve access to climate-resilient urban service; and RA2: improve urban service delivery arrangements.
